text: Alright folks, the league is starting to feel like a broken record this week, with Deagle's Team still clinging to the top spot, and Justin Do and Olivier right on his heels.  Nobody made any significant ground or lost any steam, which is a bit disappointing for The Camaraderie as Olivier only managed a slight climb into third, while Francis Desrosiers' Frank's team and Tristan Scandar's Mattress Dobes are just stuck in neutral around him.  The real drama, if you can call it that, is happening down in the trenches where a cluster of teams from 7th to 11th are playing musical chairs, and I'm looking at you, La saucisse and Mohamad Lasania, you need to start putting some points on the board.  Get ready for some fireworks next week because I've got a feeling someone’s going to break this stalemate, and it won't be the guys who are just happy to be here.
